column1: # The interface zones (tools\module_lint.py reads this file; docs\ARCHITECTURE.md "The two interfaces"). One row per path prefix: a folder, a file,
# or a file's stem ("core/ui/winplates." holds the .cpp and the .h); the longest prefix that matches a source wins. Every source under core\ and modules\
#   zone    hud2     HUD 2 only: HUD 2's code. A change here must not reach the classic HUD.
#           shared   runs under both interfaces: the classic HUD and HUD 2 both depend on it.
#           classic  classic only: runs, or draws, only while the game's own HUD is up.
#           door     the door between core and HUD 2 (core\ui\hud_door.*): core reaches HUD 2 only through it; its own uses are counted apart.
#   checks  the classic checks a change in the file needs, by the ids of CHECKS in module_lint.py; "-" none: no draw, no layout, no decision about
#           what an interface shows (the module's own tests cover it). module_lint.py --changed prints them for a list of changed files.

column4: why
The DLL's base: entry, loader, logs, strings, settings and their bus, the module rules, FLUF awareness. Both interfaces read it alike; nothing here draws.
Every Freelancer.exe address, the UI's controls and hooks too: a changed UI symbol reaches the classic HUD.
Every detour and patch, the UI hooks' too, installed under both interfaces.
The game's strings and infocards, read by the pad's screens and by HUD 2's pages.
The HUD bus: HUD 2's layout, the pad's lane and floor, read by the subtitles; no HUD 2 publisher means the classic placement.
The UI hit points' ids: the pad's and HUD 2's click boxes on the game's windows.
The options page's generated rows, the classic HUD's and HUD 2's.
The host's hooks and services: events, input injection, focus, fixes, the debug channels. Installed under both interfaces; none draws.
Every hook two modules share, in one fixed order, the UI's included.
The game's UI pass and window hooks (the UI generation, the muted draws): every window on both interfaces.
The UI hit points: the pad's and HUD 2's click boxes on the game's windows.
Core's page host: runs the HUD and the autopilot with the controller off.
The logic's entry, the module table and core's page frame: which modules run for each module set; alone.cpp registers the HUD's rows with the controller off.
The shared game layer's readers and rules (space, AI, flight, routes, missions, data): every module calls them alike; nothing here draws or decides what an interface shows.
The frame: calls HUD 2's entries and, with the HUD module off, the classic pass (coreframe.cpp:205-208), in one order for every module set.
The mode every module reads: a HUD 2 fix changed it under the classic HUD (e0110e3f).
The module slots and their guards: which entries run for each module set.
The host's services for every module part, the HUD's and the controller's alike.
The draw base: the pad's layer, the prompt bar, the subtitles and HUD 2 draw through it.
The game's panel looks as replicas: the space HUD's panel, the subtitles' panel, the options rows.
The game's fonts, rasterised for every text FLvibed draws.
The characters FLvibed's fonts hold.
The one text-fit rule for every text FLvibed draws.
The prompt lane's fit: the pad's prompt bar and wheel, HUD 2's lanes.
A text too long for its room scrolls: used by core\ui\hud2_kit, so by everything drawn with the kit.
The game's flat icons as one atlas, loaded by core\ui\hud2_kit (drawn on both interfaces).
The draw base's fonts without the device (raster, packing, glyph lookup): every text FLvibed draws.
The flat icons' decoding without the device, which core\game\flicons uploads (drawn on both interfaces).
game_text_size's table: an extra kept on both interfaces.
hud_size: the scale, the text floor and Large's margins every layout reads.
Large's margins and text, read by the pad's screens and by HUD 2.
The handheld presets behind hud_size (the Steam Deck's 1280x800).
The handheld presets' table.
HUD 2's contextual fade and the idle cursor's step; the idle-cursor hide is an extra kept on both interfaces.
The shield cue's hit look from the game's data: the cue is kept on both interfaces.
What a HUD needs to know (groups, names, states): the pad's legend, the autopilot and HUD 2 read it.
The NeuroNet's tabs over the game's window manager: HUD 2's strip and the pad's bumpers both press through it.
The NeuroNet's tabs, pure: the strip and the pad step them.
The nav map's zoom and pan on the game's own transform: the pad's map, the options page and HUD 2's map.
Rooms and their hotspots: the pad's rooms, HUD 2's strip and card.
Where the player is docked: the pad's base screens and HUD 2's pages.
The game's comm window, placed by the subtitles' panel or by HUD 2.
The game's menus as read: the pad's menus and the skin's.
The game's target indicators as data: only HUD 2's targeting display reads them.

Game-data reader: item and ship facts for the screen models of both interfaces (the dealers' probe, core\game\dealers_probe.cpp, and the page framework's models; audit 78_, 12 Nov 2026). Includes nothing of HUD 2's.
Hardpoints and equipment numbers as pure rules, gamedata's: shared with it (audit 78_).
When HUD 2's context prompts show (hud_prompts).
The game's text by role: window_text, HUD 2 only.
Core's UI: the row kit, glyphs, presets, the flight modals, FLUF's windows, the game's controls: the pad's screens on both interfaces.
The views between modules: the HUD's and the skin's entries every other module branches on.
The game's windows as the pad meets them and the prompt lane's keep-outs on both interfaces; holds ClassicPass (winplates.cpp:1295) and reads HUD 2's state (:1196, :1289, :1361).
A window's panels fitted to what they hold, measured by winplates.
The game's own name card under ui_style 0: the classic HUD, and HUD 2 with the game's menus.
HUD 2's draw kit, but the prompt bar, the wheel, the goal panel and the options page draw with it on the classic HUD too.
The door: core's frame, the options page and the window plates call HUD 2 through it; it counts the calls into HUD 2 under the classic HUD (huddoor).
Both interfaces' rows in one block: the cues' and game_text_size's beside HUD 2's.
The options page, on both interfaces (its HUD 2 look under ui_style 1).
The options page's pure rules.
The UI settings as the modules read them, HUD 2's beside the pad's.
The rows of [Controller] that act with the controller off.
The autopilot's flight, assessment and goal queue: runs under both interfaces, draws nothing.
The goal panel, drawn on both interfaces with two chromes (goals.cpp:771).
The autopilot's button on the game's maneuver bar.
The pad reader, haptics, the debug channel and the host part: both interfaces read the pad alike; nothing here draws.
The pad's options, flight dispatch and places in core's frame: fills HUD 2's context (controller.cpp:251) and drives the pad layer (:381).
The pad layer on the game's HUD (badges, legend, status line, world prompts): its draw returns at once while HUD 2 is up (padhud.cpp:506).
The pad in bases, dealers and NeuroNet windows on both interfaces; it branches on HUD 2's pages and strip.
The dealers' pad rules.
The pad in the menus and dialogs, the game's and the skin's.
The pad on the nav map and its two zones; HUD 2's chips are its panel zone.
The New Game prompt and the load screens' tags.
The on-screen keyboard.
The prompt bar of every pad screen with two pill looks (promptbar.cpp:790); it publishes the lane and floor the subtitles keep clear of.
The action wheel, in HUD 2's look and in the classic one.
The target picker.
The group editor and its rules.
The ring of a room's items.
Window mode and fit: under both interfaces, no HUD.
HUD 2: the flight HUD, Extended HUD 2's skin, the docked strip, the NeuroNet and base pages, the map, the dialogs, its theme.
The HUD module's table: the extras' entry beside HUD 2's (hud2_entry.cpp, zone hud2, where hud_style's mapping now is).
The extras, kept on both interfaces: their entry (extras.cpp: views::extras, the idle cursor's hide), the shield and hull cue, the reticle cue. Includes no file of HUD 2's.
game_text_size, kept on both interfaces.
The HUD module's host calls, the cues' too.
The model probe (audit R3b): a test verb that asks the model slot (modelslot.*, zone hud2: called only from HUD 2's pass under the UI) for 3D models; it draws only when asked.
The movies' fit and skip: no HUD.
The stall recorder and watch: no draw.
The clock, the split detector, the LiveSplit client: no draw.
The timer on screen: under HUD 2's target card, else its classic place (runtimer.cpp:154).
The New Game list on keyboard and mouse.
The subtitles' lines, speakers, names, chat and movie data: no placement.
The subtitles' display: places its panel by HUD 2's layout or the classic HUD's (display.cpp:2029).
The stacked speakers' fit on screen.
The side chat's text size.
The subtitles' line breaking.
